verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֬חַ׀ לְדָוִֽד׃ לְעֶֽבֶד־ יְהוָ֬ה נְאֻֽם־ בְּקֶ֣רֶב לִבִּ֑י פֶּ֣שַׁע לָ֭רָשָׁע אֵֽין־ פַּ֥חַד אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ lə·ḏā·wiḏ lə·‘e·ḇeḏ- Yah·weh nə·’um- bə·qe·reḇ lib·bî pe·ša‘ lā·rā·šā‘ ’ên- pa·ḥaḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·ne·ḡeḏ ‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David the servant of the LORD An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man There is no fear of God before his eyes

verses.original: כִּֽי־ בְּעֵינָ֑יו הֶחֱלִ֣יק אֵלָ֣יו לִמְצֹ֖א לִשְׂנֹֽא׃ עֲוֺנ֣וֹ
verses.literal: For his eyes are too full of conceit . . . to detect or hate his own sin

verses.original: דִּבְרֵי־ פִ֭יו אָ֣וֶן וּמִרְמָ֑ה חָדַ֖ל לְהַשְׂכִּ֣יל לְהֵיטִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: diḇ·rê- p̄îw ’ā·wen ū·mir·māh ḥā·ḏal lə·haś·kîl lə·hê·ṭîḇ
verses.literal: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful he has ceased to be wise [and] well-doing

verses.original: עַֽל־ מִשְׁכָּ֫ב֥וֹ יַחְשֹׁ֗ב אָ֤וֶן׀ יִ֭תְיַצֵּב עַל־ דֶּ֣רֶךְ לֹא־ ט֑וֹב לֹ֣א יִמְאָֽס׃ רָ֝֗ע
verses.transliteration: ‘al- miš·kā·ḇōw yaḥ·šōḇ ’ā·wen yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ ‘al- de·reḵ lō- ṭō·wḇ lō yim·’ās rā‘
verses.literal: Even on his bed he plots wickedness he sets himself on a path that is not good he fails to reject evil

verses.original: חַסְדֶּ֑ךָ יְ֭הוָה בְּהַשָּׁמַ֣יִם אֱ֝מֽוּנָתְךָ֗ עַד־ שְׁחָקִֽים׃
verses.literal: Your loving devotion O LORD reaches to the heavens Your faithfulness to the clouds

verses.original: צִדְקָֽתְךָ֨׀ אֵ֗ל כְּֽהַרְרֵי־ מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶךָ תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֑ה יְהוָֽה׃ תוֹשִׁ֣יעַ אָ֤דָֽם־ וּבְהֵמָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā ’êl kə·har·rê- miš·pā·ṭe·ḵā tə·hō·wm rab·bāh Yah·weh ṯō·wō·šî·a‘ ’ā·ḏām- ū·ḇə·hê·māh
verses.literal: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains Your judgments [are] like the deepest sea . . . O LORD You preserve man and beast

verses.original: מַה־ יָּקָ֥ר חַסְדְּךָ֗ אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים וּבְנֵ֥י אָדָ֑ם יֶחֱסָיֽוּן׃ בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ
verses.transliteration: mah- yā·qār ḥas·də·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·ḇə·nê ’ā·ḏām ye·ḥĕ·sā·yūn bə·ṣêl kə·nā·p̄e·ḵā
verses.literal: How precious is Your loving devotion O God that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings

verses.original: יִ֭רְוְיֻן מִדֶּ֣שֶׁן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ תַשְׁקֵֽם׃ וְנַ֖חַל עֲדָנֶ֣יךָ
verses.literal: They feast on the abundance of Your house and You give them drink from Your river of delights

verses.original: כִּֽי־ עִ֭מְּךָ מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים בְּ֝אוֹרְךָ֗ נִרְאֶה־ אֽוֹר׃
verses.literal: For with You is the fountain of life in Your light we see light

verses.original: מְשֹׁ֣ךְ חַ֭סְדְּךָ לְיֹדְעֶ֑יךָ וְ֝צִדְקָֽתְךָ֗ לְיִשְׁרֵי־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: mə·šōḵ ḥas·də·ḵā lə·yō·ḏə·‘e·ḵā wə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯə·ḵā lə·yiš·rê- lêḇ
verses.literal: Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You and Your righteousness to the upright in heart

verses.original: אַל־ רֶ֣גֶל גַּאֲוָ֑ה תְּ֭בוֹאֵנִי וְיַד־ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תְּנִדֵֽנִי׃ אַל־
verses.transliteration: ’al- re·ḡel ga·’ă·wāh tə·ḇō·w·’ê·nî wə·yaḏ- rə·šā·‘îm tə·ni·ḏê·nî ’al-
verses.literal: Let not the foot of the proud come against me nor the hand of the wicked drive me away

verses.original: שָׁ֣ם פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן נָ֭פְלוּ דֹּ֝ח֗וּ וְלֹא־ יָ֥כְלוּ קֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: šām pō·‘ă·lê ’ā·wen nā·p̄ə·lū dō·ḥū wə·lō- yā·ḵə·lū qūm
verses.literal: There the evildoers . . . lie fallen thrown down and unable . . . to rise
